Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Harmony Lane, Suite 100, Arts District, CA 90210-1234
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: The Creative Arts Academy provides a variety of dance, drama, and music instruction for students of all ages. Our programs include ballet, hip-hop, jazz dance, acting classes, vocal lessons, and instrument training. We focus on fostering creativity, self-expression, and teamwork through performing arts. Our experienced instructors ensure a supportive and engaging environment, where students can develop their skills and confidence. We also host performances and showcases to encourage student participation in the arts community.
